column1: # manifest/categories.tsv — the auxiliary category inventory (DATA, never code).
# The reader is the AGENT following the init brief's "external categories" section; no
# gobstack executable line reads this file. init vendors it to .gob/engine/categories.tsv
# (hash-pinned in installed.json like every other engine file), so the target's copy is
# pinned to this repo of origin.
#   category  the composition category (a stable name the brief and decisions cite)
#   source    the upstream repository (the URL `added_by` records on install)
#   license   the upstream license (a row with a pending/unknown license must not be listed)
#   provides  what the pack would add, as skills/docs/checklists — never pre-built payloads
#   fits_when the predicate the AGENT evaluates against THIS repo (data, not code: the
#             agent is the adjudicator because it can read the repo; gobstack's code cannot)
# Rows are appended only with a verified upstream license and a real fetchable source.
